meta.titulo: Porsche 991 Carrera S Cabrio · Valentin Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 911 Carrera S Cabrio 991.1, 2014, 7-speed manual, 122.000 km, Agate Grey, full service book, 12-month warranty. Price: 89.900 €.

hero.claim: 7 speed manual. Open sky and character S.

parrafos: This Porsche 911 Carrera S Cabrio of the 991.1 generation combines the open silhouette of the 911 with a configuration especially oriented to driving: seven-speed manual transmission, self-locking differential at 40 %, suspension PASM and wheels Carrera Classic II of 20 inches.
Produced on 27 June 2013 as a 2014 model, it comes in Agate Grey M7S color, combined with black interior, sports seats Plus, heating in the front seats and BOSE sound package.
intro.cita: A Carrera S Manual Convertible with complete history and a particularly balanced dynamic setup.

fotos.caption: Complete profile · Wheels Carrera Classic II
Open convertible · View from the rear seats

parrafos: The flat-six engine atmospheric 3,8 liters develops 400 CV and is managed through a seven speed manual transmission, option code 487, one of the elements that defines this unit. It allows you to directly manage the engine's delivery and turns each ratio change into an active part of driving, fitting especially well with the open character of the Carrera S Cabrio.

The system PASM (code 475) allows you to adapt the response of the suspension, combining comfortable use with a firmer fit when sporty driving is desired. The self-locking differential at 40 % (code 220) contributes to managing the traction of the rear axle.
The result is a balanced configuration between sporty driving, road use and everyday enjoyment, supported by the Carrera Classic II wheels of 20 inches and their red brake calipers.

exterior.texto: The Agate Grey color adds depth to the surfaces of the 991.1 and allows the transition between the bonnet, front wings, doors and rear wheel arches to be clearly read. The Carrera Classic II wheels of 20 inches introduce a technical contrast through their dark spokes and machined surfaces, while the red calipers provide a visible accent without altering the overall sobriety of the configuration. With the top open, the line of the car becomes more horizontal.

interior.editorial: The interior retains the wraparound architecture of the 991.1, with a raised center console that groups controls around the driver. Plus sport seats combine lateral support with a road-usable configuration, while front heating improves comfort during open driving on cool days. The seven-speed manual lever occupies a leading place: it is the element that best summarizes the character of this unit.

hitos.cuerpo: Unit produced on 27 June 2013 and marketed as model 2014, with chassis number WP0ZZZ99ZES145561 and configuration Carrera S Convertible of the 991.1 generation.
The unit has a complete service book, an essential element to contextualize its journey and the servicing carried out over time. Mileage: 122.000 km.
The unit is offered with 12 months of warranty, in accordance with the applicable contractual conditions. Coverage subject to the terms, limits, exclusions and conditions included in the warranty.

opinion.bio: More than 25 years of experience with collectible Porsche. He has supervised hundreds of special vehicle purchase and sale operations, with special focus on dynamic configurations of the 911 range.
opinion.intro: "The 991.1 Carrera S Cabrio with manual transmission is the configuration that returns the driver to a central role, without giving up the open sky."
parrafos: The Porsche 991 It represented an important evolution in refinement, stability and daily use, but this unit retains a particularly mechanical component thanks to its flat-six engine atmospheric 3,8 liters and 400 CV, managed by a seven speed manual transmission. The change requires greater driver participation and establishes a more direct relationship between engine speed, speed and car response.

In a body Convertible, this interaction is combined with an open, sensory experience. The PASM system allows the response of the suspension to be varied, while the self-locking differential contributes to managing the traction of the rear axle.

The Agate Grey color, the Carrera Classic II wheels and the red calipers complete a sober exterior configuration but with well-defined technical accents. Inside, the heated Plus sports seats and the BOSE package provide everyday equipment consistent with the sporty character of the unit.
The main value of this unit is in the combination of Carrera S, Convertible and manual transmission, backed by a full service booklet and 12 months of warranty.
